critical_code_review_comments: Platform-file split is the idiomatic Metro pattern and works exactly as expected — the web bundle no longer walks into react-native-youtube-iframe. Good.
VideoPlayer.tsx (web) uses React.createElement('iframe', ...) which correctly avoids the JSX-in-RN-tree lint warnings and produces a native DOM iframe on web. Clean.
VideoPlayer.native.tsx handles the vimeo branch via a raw <WebView> and the youtube branch via <YoutubePlayer> — sensible; the ready/ActivityIndicator UX is a nice touch.
